verdict.rationale: Mistral's own docs describe a first-party moderation capability. 'Custom Guardrails' lets developers declare moderation rules directly in API requests, which is a direct guardrail primitive for gating model output. The pack shows only short snippets from one moderation page, so the depth of the feature is unproven. missing for 10: documented moderation categories/thresholds and response behavior, a standalone moderation endpoint or safety-setting details, documented patterns for gating output before tool/agent actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the platform gives me guardrail primitives — moderation endpoints, safety settings, or documented patterns for gating model output before it acts

citations.quote: Custom Guardrails (recommended): Declare moderation rules directly in your API requests.
Declare moderation rules directly in your API requests. No separate calls or threshold logic in your code.
